tips: [Radial.Menu] By default, hold left Alt or a Ctrl key to open the radial menu on the campaign map.
[Radial.Menu] Change hotkeys, mouse bindings and wheel settings in the main menu LunaSettings.
[Radial.Menu] You can have up to 10 slots in the main wheel. Change the number in LunaSettings.
[Radial.Menu] To edit a radial menu slot, hold the left mouse button over it for half a second.
[Radial.Menu] You can add submenus to the radial menu to assign more slots or group abilities together.
[Radial.Menu] To cancel a radial menu selection, move the cursor to the center before releasing the hotkey, or press Escape.
